notes_for_human: HIGH-VALUE AND COUNTERINTUITIVE FINDING ON SPONSORSHIP: KPMG US does NOT publish a blanket no-sponsorship statement on its early-career hub. The opposite is published, verbatim: "KPMG early career opportunities include jobs that will consider qualified applicants who require visa sponsorship." It is then scoped by named practice. Two verbatim scoping sentences exist on the same page - the regular-basis list (Korean/Japanese Audit and Business Tax Services practices) is captured in a row above; the second reads verbatim: "Practices that historically consider candidates requiring sponsorship on a limited basis: Select Tax jobs, Audit Data Engineering". Do NOT let this be summarized into "KPMG sponsors international students" - the stated policy is practice-scoped, and the page is silent on the mainstream Audit and Advisory internships. Equally, do not infer from that silence that those roles refuse sponsorship. CLASS_YEAR IS THE BIGGEST GAP: every individual 2027 intern posting on kpmguscareers.com/jobdetail/ returns "This job has been filled or is no longer available." to a non-browser fetch, so the CPA-licensure / credit-hour eligibility sentence that lives inside each posting could NOT be captured verbatim. Search-engine snippets suggest postings say candidates must be pursuing educational requirements for CPA licensure in the principal place of business, and that Embark requires roughly 3 additional semesters remaining post-internship - BOTH were deliberately left unquoted because neither could be confirmed character-for-character on a KPMG-owned page. These two rows need a browser-rendered re-check before publication. COOLING_OFF: entirely unresearched, not silent - the early-career FAQ URL 404s and no alternative FAQ was found. "Discover KPMG" appears to not exist as a KPMG US program name; the actual KPMG US program roster on the programs page is Embark Scholars, HBCU Talent+, KPMG Advisory Talent Program, Rise, Ace the Case, Global Advantage, and the Global Internship Program. Ace the Case and Global Advantage were surfaced but not researched; they are candidates for the sophomore/first-year track the request was looking for. No tier-2 or tier-3 sources were used anywhere in this output; every quote is from kpmguscareers.com.
